html: † סַרְגֿוֹן n.pr.m. Sargon (Assyrian Šargânu, and (prob. by pop. etymol.) Šarrukênu = firm, faithful, king, v. reff. infr.);—king of Assyria b.c. 722–705, conqueror of Samaria, father of Sennacherib, only Is 20:1 (𝔊 Αρνα, Aq Theod Σαραγω̄, Symm Σαργων [Qmg]); PtolCanon Ἀρκεάνου (genit.); cf. SchrCOT ad loc. TieleGesch. 238 ff..
